semantics.accessControl: The source repository's existing access controls remain authoritative.
semantics.activation: All retrieved code and instructions remain inert until separately approved and verified.
semantics.authority: A repository URL, Git reference, chant, card, or QR code is a locator only.
guarantees: The locator names one repository and one exact Git commit.
Transport uses standard HTTPS or Git operations supported by the source host.
nonGuarantees: No authority over a Hive or ecosystem is inferred.
No semantic compatibility with any other protocol is inferred.
No retrieved code is safe or executable merely because it was located.
semantics.purpose: Locate immutable repository bytes at an exact Git commit.
